_AUDIT.notice: PROBE PRECISION AUDIT (2026-07-31): several frequencies in this file are NOT citable.

do_not_cite.god_dedication: precision 6% - nam-lugal 'kingship' and nam-en 'lordship' are abstract nouns, not dedications
do_not_cite.excess_diri: precision 19% - diri before a month name marks an INTERCALARY MONTH, not a ledger surplus
do_not_cite.year_formula: precision 34% - '-' is a regex word boundary, so \bmu\b matches the verbal prefixes mu-na-/mu-un-/mu-ni-
do_not_cite.king_title: precision 42% - mostly lugal- as a personal-name element; bare lugal in Ur III admin often means 'owner/master'

precision_validated.total_audit: 100% precise, but only 2.2% of Administrative tablets - rare, not characteristic
precision_validated.seal_of_PN: 96% - kisib3-bi N ('its sealed tablets: N') is the only notable contaminant

_AUDIT.prevalence_warning: Attested is not the same as characteristic. A probe can be 100% precise and still describe a rare practice: total_audit (šu-nigin₂) is precise but appears on only 2.2% of Administrative tablets. Check the prevalence table in probe_validation.md before calling any pattern typical.
_AUDIT.withdrawn_claims: See CORRECTIONS.md — the RULING-parity and Zipf-as-DSL findings were withdrawn.
